title.zh: 卷六 本紀第六: 後主
title.raw: 卷六 本紀第六: 後主 Volume 6: Houzhu

sentences.zh: 陳書卷六

translations.literal: Book of Chen, Volume 6
translations.idiomatic: Book of Chen, Volume 6

sentences.zh: 本紀第六

translations.literal: Basic Annals, Number Six
translations.idiomatic: Annals, Part Six

sentences.zh: 後主諱叔寶，字元秀，小字黃奴，高宗嫡長子也。

translations.literal: The Last Emperor, taboo name Shubao, style Yuanxiu, childhood name Huangnu, was the legitimate eldest son of Emperor Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Last Emperor, whose personal name was tabooed as Shubao, who styled himself Yuanxiu and in youth was called Huangnu, was the legitimate eldest son of Emperor Xuan.

sentences.zh: 梁承聖二年十一月戊寅生于江陵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, wuyin day, of the second year of Liang's Chengsheng era, he was born at Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on wuyin day in the eleventh month of Liang's Chengsheng year 2 (553) at Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 明年，江陵陷，高宗遷關右，留後主于穰城。

translations.literal: The next year Jiangling fell; Emperor Xuan was moved to the Guan region, and the Last Emperor was left at Rang city.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Jiangling fell; Emperor Xuan was taken west to the Guan region, and the Last Emperor was left at Rang.

sentences.zh: 天嘉三年，歸京師，立為安成王世子。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianjia he returned to the capital and was established as heir of the Prince of Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianjia year 3 (564) he returned to the capital and was made heir of the Prince of Ancheng.

sentences.zh: 天康元年，授寧遠將軍，置佐史。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiankang he was appointed General of Far Pacification, with aides and clerks.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiankang year 1 (566) he was made general of far pacification, with aides and clerks.

sentences.zh: 光大二年，為太子中庶子，尋遷侍中，餘如故。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangda he became junior mentor of the heir apparent; soon he was transferred to palace attendant, the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangda year 2 (567) he became junior mentor of the heir apparent, then palace attendant, other offices unchanged.

sentences.zh: 太建元年正月甲午，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the first month, jiawu day, of the first year of Taijian, he was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day in the first month of Taijian year 1 (569) he was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月甲寅，高宗崩。

translations.literal: In the first month, jiayin day, of the fourteenth year, Emperor Xuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day in the first month of year 14, Emperor Xuan died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，始興王叔陵作逆，伏誅。

translations.literal: On yimao day the Prince of Shixing Shuling rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Prince Shuling of Shixing rebelled and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太子即皇帝位于太極前殿。

translations.literal: On dingsi day the crown prince took the throne as emperor in the hall before the Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the crown prince ascended the throne in the hall before the Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「上天降禍，大行皇帝奄棄萬國，攀號擗踊，無所迨及。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Heaven has sent down calamity; the late emperor has abruptly abandoned the myriad realms. We wail and beat our breasts, unable to reach him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Heaven has sent down calamity; the late emperor has suddenly left the realm. We wail and beat our breasts, unable to reach him.

sentences.zh: 朕以哀煢，嗣膺寶歷，若涉巨川，罔知攸濟，方賴群公，用匡寡薄。

translations.literal: We, orphaned and alone, have succeeded to the precious succession; it is as if crossing a great river, not knowing how to cross—We must rely on you lords to shore up Our feebleness.
translations.idiomatic: We, orphaned and alone, have taken the throne; it is like crossing a great river without knowing the ford—we must rely on you lords to steady Our weakness.

sentences.zh: 思播遺德，覃被億兆，凡厥遐邇，咸與惟新。

translations.literal: We think to spread his surviving virtue and extend it to the hundred millions; all near and far alike shall share in renewal.
translations.idiomatic: We mean to spread his surviving virtue to the hundred millions; near and far alike shall share in renewal.

sentences.zh: 可大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty is proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 在位文武及孝悌力田為父後者，並賜爵一級。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials in office, and filial sons, dutiful brothers, and strong farmers who are heirs to their fathers, are each granted one step of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials in post, and the filial, the dutiful, strong farmers, and heirs, each receive one step of nobility.

sentences.zh: 孤老鰥寡不能自存者，賜穀人五斛、帛二匹。

translations.literal: The solitary old, widowers, and widows who cannot support themselves are each given five hu of grain and two bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: The solitary old, widowers, and widows who cannot support themselves receive five hu of grain and two bolts of silk each.

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，以侍中、翊前將軍、丹陽尹長沙王叔堅為驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司、揚州刺史，右衛將軍蕭摩訶為車騎將軍、南徐州刺史，[1]鎮西將軍、荊州刺史樊毅進號征西將軍，平南將軍、豫州刺史任忠進號鎮南將軍，[2]護軍將軍沈恪為特進、金紫光祿大夫，平西將軍魯廣達進號安西將軍，仁武將軍、豐州刺史章大寶為中護軍。

translations.literal: " On guihai day the palace attendant, aide-before-the-throne general, and Administrator of Danyang, Prince of Changsha Shujian, was made general of agile cavalry, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of Yangzhou; Right Guard General Xiao Mohe was made general of chariots and cavalry and Inspector of South Xuzhou, Editorial footnote marker 1. Garrison West General and Inspector of Jingzhou Fan Yi was advanced in title to General Who Campaigns West; Pacify South General and Inspector of Yuzhou Ren Zhong was advanced in title to General Who Garrisons South, Editorial footnote marker 2. Protector General Shen Ke was made special grand master and grand master for the imperial insignia; Pacify West General Lu Guangda was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies West; Benevolent Martial General and Inspector of Fengzhou Zhang Dabao was made protector general.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Shujian, Prince of Changsha, palace attendant, aide-before-the-throne general, and administrator of Danyang, was made general of agile cavalry with a mansion equal to the three dukes and inspector of Yangzhou; Xiao Mohe, right guard general, was made general of chariots and cavalry and inspector of South Xuzhou [1]; Fan Yi, garrison west general and inspector of Jingzhou, was promoted to general who campaigns west; Ren Zhong, pacify south general and inspector of Yuzhou, to general who garrisons south [2]; Shen Ke, protector general, to special grand master with the golden seal and purple ribbon; Lu Guangda, pacify west general, to general who pacifies west; Zhang Dabao, benevolent martial general and inspector of Fengzhou, to protector general.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，尊皇后為皇太后，宮曰弘範。

translations.literal: On yichou day the empress was honored as empress dowager; her palace was named Broad Pattern.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the empress was honored as empress dowager, her palace named Broad Pattern.

sentences.zh: 景寅，以冠軍將軍晉熙王叔文為宣惠將軍、丹陽尹。

translations.literal: On gengyin day the Champion General, Prince of Jinxi Shuwu, was made Manifest Grace General and Administrator of Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Shuwu, Prince of Jinxi, champion general, was made manifest grace general and administrator of Danyang.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，立弟叔重為始興王，[3]奉昭烈王祀。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the younger brother Shuzhong was established as Prince of Shixing, Editorial footnote marker 3. to maintain the sacrifices of Prince Zhao-lie.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the younger brother Shuzhong was made Prince of Shixing [3] to tend Prince Zhao-lie's shrine.

sentences.zh: 己巳，立妃沈氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On jisi day Consort Shen was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Lady Shen was made empress.

sentences.zh: 辛未，立皇弟叔儼為尋陽王，皇弟叔慎為岳陽王，[4]皇弟叔達為義陽王，皇弟叔熊為巴山王，[5]皇弟叔虞為武昌王。

translations.literal: On xinwei day the imperial younger brother Shuyan was established as Prince of Xunyang; the imperial younger brother Shushen as Prince of Yueyang, Editorial footnote marker 4. the imperial younger brother Shuda as Prince of Yiyang; the imperial younger brother Shuxiong as Prince of Bashan, Editorial footnote marker 5. the imperial younger brother Shuyu as Prince of Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the imperial brother Shuyan was made Prince of Xunyang; Shushen Prince of Yueyang [4]; Shuda Prince of Yiyang; Shuxiong Prince of Bashan [5]; Shuyu Prince of Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 壬申，侍中、中權將軍、開府儀同三司鄱陽王伯山進號中權大將軍，軍師將軍、尚書左僕射晉安王伯恭進號翊前將軍、侍中，翊右將軍、中領軍廬陵王伯仁進號安前將軍，[6]鎮南將軍、江州刺史豫章王叔英進號征南將軍，平南將軍、湘州刺史建安王叔卿進號安南將軍。

translations.literal: On renshen day the palace attendant, central authority general, and opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Prince of Poyang Boshan, was advanced in title to Grand General of Central Authority; Military Adviser General and Left Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing, Prince of Jin'an Bogong, was advanced in title to Aide-before-the-Throne General and palace attendant; Aide-right General and Central Army Commander, Prince of Luling Boren, was advanced in title to General Who Secures the Van, Editorial footnote marker 6. Garrison South General and Inspector of Jiangzhou, Prince of Yuzhang Shuying, was advanced in title to General Who Campaigns South; Pacify South General and Inspector of Xiangzhou, Prince of Jian'an Shuqing, was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies South.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Boshan, Prince of Poyang, palace attendant, central authority general, and opener equal to the three dukes, was promoted to grand general of central authority; Bogong, Prince of Jin'an, military adviser general and left vice minister, to aide-before-the-throne general and palace attendant; Boren, Prince of Luling, aide-right general and central army commander, to general who secures the van [6]; Shuying, Prince of Yuzhang, garrison south general and Jiangzhou inspector, to general who campaigns south; Shuqing, Prince of Jian'an, pacify south general and Xiangzhou inspector, to general who pacifies south.

sentences.zh: 以侍中、中書監、安右將軍徐陵為左光祿大夫，領太子少傅。

translations.literal: The palace attendant, Secretariat Supervisor, and Secure-the-Right General Xu Ling was made Left Grand Master of the Glory and concurrently Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Ling, palace attendant, secretariat supervisor, and secure-the-right general, was made left grand master of the glory and junior tutor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，設無㝵大會於太極前殿。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day a Boundless Assembly was held in the hall before the Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day a Boundless Assembly was held in the hall before the Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，詔曰：「躬推為勸，義顯前經，力農見賞，事昭往誥。

translations.literal: In the third month, xinhai day, an edict said: "Taking the plow as encouragement—its meaning shines in the former classics; rewarding strength in farming—its matter is proclaimed in past edicts.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on xinhai day an edict said: "To take the plow as encouragement is plain in the classics; to reward strong farming was proclaimed in old edicts.

sentences.zh: 斯乃國儲是資，民命攸屬，豐儉隆替，靡不由之。

translations.literal: These are what nourish the state's granaries and bind the people's lives; whether harvest is rich or lean, high or low, none is without them.
translations.idiomatic: These nourish the state's granaries and bind the people's lives; whether the year is rich or lean, none can do without them.

sentences.zh: 夫入賦自古，輸藁惟舊，沃饒貴于十金，磽确至於三易，腴塉既異，盈縮不同。

translations.literal: Land tax is ancient; delivering straw is of old. Fertile fields are prized at ten gold; stony ground may require three rotations—rich and poor soil differ, and full measure and shortfall are not the same.
translations.idiomatic: Land tax is ancient and delivering straw is old; fertile fields are worth ten gold, stony ground three rotations—soil differs and levies differ.

sentences.zh: 詐偽日興，簿書歲改。

translations.literal: Fraud rises day by day; registers change year by year.
translations.idiomatic: Fraud rises daily; registers change yearly.

sentences.zh: 稻田使者，著自西京，不實峻刑，聞諸東漢。

translations.literal: The Paddy-Field Commissioner is recorded from Western Han; harsh penalties for false returns are heard of in Eastern Han.
translations.idiomatic: The paddy-field commissioner dates to Western Han; harsh penalties for false returns are known from Eastern Han.

sentences.zh: 老農懼於祇應，俗吏因以侮文。

translations.literal: Old farmers fear the summons; vulgar clerks therefore mock the documents.
translations.idiomatic: Old farmers dread the summons; petty clerks mock the documents.

sentences.zh: 輟耒成群，游手為伍，永言妨蠹，良可太息。

translations.literal: They leave the plow in bands; idlers gather in companies—long to speak of this harm to the silkworm season is cause for deep sighing.
translations.idiomatic: They leave the plow in bands and idle in companies—to speak of this harm to the silkworm season is cause for deep sighing.

sentences.zh: 今陽和在節，膏澤潤下，宜展春耨，以望秋坻。

translations.literal: Now the yang principle is in season and sweet rain moistens the land; spring harrowing should be spread to await the autumn mound.
translations.idiomatic: Now spring is in season and sweet rain moistens the land; spring harrowing should spread to await the autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 其有新辟塍畎，進墾蒿萊，廣袤勿得度量，征租悉皆停免。

translations.literal: Those who newly open furrows and advance reclamation into overgrown wilds—however broad, no measure shall be taken; levies and rents are all stopped and remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever newly opens furrows or advances reclamation into wild land—however broad—shall pay no measure; levies and rents are all remitted.

sentences.zh: 私業久廢，咸許占作，公田荒縱，亦隨肆勤。

translations.literal: Private fields long abandoned may all be claimed and worked; public fields left wild may likewise be freely tilled.
translations.idiomatic: Private fields long abandoned may be claimed and worked; public fields left wild may be freely tilled.

sentences.zh: 儻良守教耕，淳民載酒，有茲督課，議以賞擢。

translations.literal: If a good magistrate teaches plowing and the plain people bring wine, such oversight and exhortation shall be discussed for reward and promotion.
translations.idiomatic: If a good magistrate teaches plowing and plain people bring wine, such oversight shall be rewarded and promoted.

sentences.zh: 外可為格班下，稱朕意焉。

translations.literal: Without, regulations may be drawn up and promulgated to declare Our intent."
translations.idiomatic: Let regulations be drawn up and promulgated without to declare Our intent."

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，詔曰：「夫體國經野，長世字氓，雖因革儻殊，弛張或異，至於旁求俊乂，爰逮側微，用適和羹，是隆大厦，上智中主，咸由此術。

translations.literal: " On guihai day an edict said: "To embody the state and order the wilds, to long govern and nurture the people—though institutions may differ in change and tension in loosening or tightening, as to broadly seeking the worthy and reaching even to the humble, using them to harmonize the stew and raise the great hall—sage and middling rulers alike have used this art.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day an edict said: "To embody the state and order the wilds, to long govern the people—though institutions differ, all sage and middling rulers have sought the worthy, even the humble, to harmonize the stew and raise the great hall.

sentences.zh: 朕以寡薄，嗣膺景祚，雖哀疚在躬，情慮惛舛，而宗社任重，黎庶務殷，無由自安拱默，敢忘康濟，思所以登顯髦彥，式備周行。

translations.literal: We, of meager worth, have succeeded to the bright throne; though mourning weighs on Our person and thoughts are confused, the altars' burden is heavy and the people's tasks many—We cannot rest in silent ease and dare forget to bring peace; We think how to raise outstanding men and complete the full array.
translations.idiomatic: We, slight in merit, have taken the bright throne; though mourning weighs on Us and thoughts tangle, the altars are heavy and the people's tasks many—we cannot sit in silent ease and dare forget to bring peace; We mean to raise outstanding men and fill every post.

sentences.zh: 但空勞宵夢，屢勤史卜，五就莫來，

translations.literal: Yet in vain We toil at night-dreams and repeatedly press the historiographers and diviners; five visits do not come,
translations.idiomatic: Yet in vain We toil at night-dreams and press historiographers and diviners; five visits do not come,

translations.literal: (five)
translations.idiomatic: (five)

sentences.zh: 〔八〕能不至。

translations.literal: [eight] abilities do not arrive.
translations.idiomatic: [eight] abilities do not arrive.

sentences.zh: [7]是用

translations.literal: Editorial footnote marker 7. Therefore
translations.idiomatic: [7] Therefore

translations.literal: (jia)
translations.idiomatic: (jia)

sentences.zh: 〔申〕旦凝慮，[8]景夜損懷。

translations.literal: [shen] from dawn We fix Our thought, Editorial footnote marker 8. by day and night We lessen Our care.
translations.idiomatic: [shen] from dawn We fix Our thought [8], by day and night We lessen Our rest.

sentences.zh: [9]豈以食玉炊桂，無因自達？

translations.literal: Editorial footnote marker 9. Is it because jade must be eaten and cassia burned that there is no way to advance?
translations.idiomatic: [9] Is it because one must eat jade and burn cassia that there is no way to advance?

sentences.zh: 將懷寶迷邦，咸思獨善？

translations.literal: Will all cherish their talent and lose their state, each thinking only to perfect himself alone?
translations.idiomatic: Will all hide talent and lose their state, each seeking only private perfection?

sentences.zh: 應內外眾官九品已上，可各薦一人，以會彙征之旨。

translations.literal: All officials within and without of the nine ranks and above may each recommend one man, to meet the purpose of gathering the eminent.
translations.idiomatic: All officials within and without of the nine ranks and above may each recommend one man, to meet the purpose of gathering the eminent.

sentences.zh: 且取備實難，舉長或易，小大之用，明言所施，勿得南箕北斗，名而非實。

translations.literal: Moreover, to take the full is difficult and to raise the long may be easy; for great and small employments, clearly state what is to be applied—do not be like the Southern Dipper or the Northern Dipper, named but not real.
translations.idiomatic: To take the full is hard and to raise the long may be easy; for great and small posts, say clearly what is offered—do not be like the Southern or Northern Dipper, named but not real.

sentences.zh: 其有負能仗氣，擯壓當時，著賓戲以自憐，草客嘲以慰志，人生一世，逢遇誠難，亦宜去此幽谷，翔茲天路，趨銅駝以觀國，望金馬而來庭，便當隨彼方圓，飭之矩矱。

translations.literal: Those who bear ability and rely on spirit, pressed down in their time, who compose guest plays to pity themselves or draft guest jibes to comfort their will—life is once, and meeting opportunity is truly hard; they too should leave this deep valley and soar on the heavenly road, hurry to the bronze camel to view the state, gaze on the golden horse and come to court; then let them follow that square or round and be trimmed to the compass and rule.
translations.idiomatic: Those who bear talent and pride, pressed down in their time, who write plays to pity themselves or jibes to comfort their will—life comes once and chance is rare; let them leave this ravine, soar on the heavenly road, hurry to the bronze camel to view the state, gaze on the golden horse and come to court, and be trimmed to the compass and rule.

sentences.zh: 」又詔曰：「昔睿后宰民，哲王御宇，雖德稱汪濊，明能普燭，猶復紆己乞言，降情訪道，高咨岳牧，下聽輿臺，故能政若神明，事無悔吝。

translations.literal: " Again an edict said: "Of old the wise queen governed the people and the philosopher-king held the realm; though virtue was called vast and brightness could shine everywhere, still they bent themselves to beg words and lowered their feeling to seek the Way, high consulting the mountain shepherds and low listening to the carriage platforms—thus government was like a spirit and affairs without regret.
translations.idiomatic: " Another edict said: "Of old the wise queen governed the people and the philosopher-king held the realm; though virtue was vast and light shone everywhere, still they bent to beg words and lowered themselves to seek the Way, consulting mountain shepherds above and carriage men below—thus government was spirit-like and affairs without regret.

sentences.zh: 朕纂承丕緒，思隆大業，常懼九重已邃，四聰未廣，欲聽昌言，不疲痺足，若逢廷折，無憚批鱗。

translations.literal: We have inherited the great thread and think to raise the great enterprise, ever fearing the ninefold barrier is already deep and the four hearings not yet broad; We wish to hear flourishing words and not weary Our afflicted feet; if We meet court remonstrance, We do not fear the scales torn.
translations.idiomatic: We have inherited the great thread and mean to raise the great enterprise, ever fearing the inner court is deep and the four hearings not broad; We wish to hear flourishing words and not weary Our feet; if We meet court remonstrance, We do not fear torn scales.

sentences.zh: 而口柔之辭，儻聞於在位，腹誹之意，或隱於具僚，非所以弘理至公，緝熙帝載者也。

translations.literal: Yet soft-mouthed words are perhaps heard among those in office, and belly-slander's meaning may hide among the full ranks—this is not the way to extend reason to utmost fairness and harmonize the emperor's record.
translations.idiomatic: Yet soft words are perhaps heard in office, and belly-slander may hide among the full ranks—this is not how to extend utmost fairness and harmonize the imperial record.

sentences.zh: 內外卿士文武眾司，若有智周政術，心練治體，救民俗之疾苦，辯禁網之疏密者，各進忠讜，無所隱諱。

translations.literal: Ministers civil and military and all offices within and without—if any have wisdom encompassing government arts and a heart trained in governing forms, who can save the people's hardship in custom or distinguish the sparse and dense in forbidden nets—let each advance loyal counsel without hiding.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers civil and military and all offices within and without—if any have wisdom in government and a heart trained in rule, who can ease the people's hardship or distinguish what is forbidden—let each advance loyal counsel without hiding.

sentences.zh: 朕將虛己聽受，擇善而行，庶深鑒物情，匡我王度。

translations.literal: We will empty Ourselves to listen and receive, choose the good and act; perhaps deeply to mirror things' feelings and correct Our royal measure.
translations.idiomatic: We will empty Ourselves to listen, choose the good and act, and deeply mirror the people's feeling to correct Our royal measure.

sentences.zh: 」己巳，以侍中、尚書左僕射、新除翊前將軍晉安王伯恭為安南將軍、湘州刺史，新除翊左將軍、永陽王伯智為尚書僕射，中護軍章大寶為豐州刺史。

translations.literal: " On jisi day the palace attendant, Left Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing, and newly appointed Aide-before-the-Throne General, Prince of Jin'an Bogong, was made General Who Pacifies South and Inspector of Xiangzhou; the newly appointed Aide-left General, Prince of Yongyang Bozhi, was made Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing; Protector General Zhang Dabao was made Inspector of Fengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Bogong, Prince of Jin'an, palace attendant, left vice minister, and newly aide-before-the-throne general, was made general who pacifies south and Xiangzhou inspector; Bozhi, Prince of Yongyang, newly aide-left general, was made vice minister; Zhang Dabao, protector general, was made Fengzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 夏四月景申，立皇子永康公胤為皇太子，賜天下為父後者爵一級，王公已下賚帛各有差。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, gengshen day, the prince Yongkang Gong Yin was established as crown prince; those throughout the realm who are heirs to their fathers are granted one step of nobility; kings, dukes, and below are bestowed silk each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer on gengshen day Prince Yin of Yongkang was made crown prince; heirs throughout the realm received one step of nobility; kings, dukes, and below received silk by rank.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔曰：「朕臨御區宇，撫育黔黎，方欲康濟澆薄，蠲省繁費，奢僭乖衷，實宜防斷。

translations.literal: On gengzi day an edict said: "We face the realm and nurture the black-haired people; We mean to bring peace to the thin and shallow and cut redundant expense; extravagance and excess against the center should truly be stopped and cut off.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict said: "We face the realm and nurture the people; We mean to bring peace to the thin age and cut waste; extravagance against the center should be stopped.

sentences.zh: 應鏤金銀薄及庶物化生土木人綵花之屬，及布帛幅尺短狹輕疏者，並傷財廢業，尤成蠹患。

translations.literal: Gilded gold and silver foil and such things as clay-and-wood men of painted flowers, and cloth and silk of short width and light weave—all injure wealth and waste industry and especially become plagues.
translations.idiomatic: Gilded gold and silver foil, clay-and-wood figures, painted flowers, and cloth of short width and light weave—all waste wealth and industry and breed plague.

sentences.zh: 又僧尼道士，挾邪左道，不依經律，民間淫祀祅書諸珍怪事，詳為條制，並皆禁絕。

translations.literal: Moreover monks and Taoist priests who embrace heterodox left ways and do not follow the canon, and among the people licentious sacrifices, demon books, and all strange marvels—let detailed regulations be drawn up and all forbidden and ended.
translations.idiomatic: Monks and Taoist priests who embrace heterodox ways and ignore the canon, and among the people licentious rites, demon books, and strange marvels—let detailed rules forbid them all.

sentences.zh: 」癸卯，詔曰：「中歲克定淮、泗，爰涉青、徐，彼土酋豪，並輸罄誠款，分遣親戚，以為質任。

translations.literal: " On guimao day an edict said: "In mid-years We settled Huai and Si and crossed into Qing and Xu; the chieftains of that land all sent full sincerity, sending kin in division to serve as hostages.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day an edict said: "In mid-years We settled Huai and Si and crossed into Qing and Xu; the chieftains there sent full sincerity and kin as hostages.

sentences.zh: 今舊土淪陷，復成異域，南北阻遠，未得會同，念其分乖，殊有愛戀。

translations.literal: Now the old land is lost and again becomes another realm; north and south are blocked far and cannot meet; thinking of their separation, We have special affection.
translations.idiomatic: Now that land is lost and again another realm; north and south are blocked and cannot meet; thinking of their separation, We have special affection.

sentences.zh: 夷狄吾民，斯事一也，何獨譏禁，使彼離析？

translations.literal: Barbarian and Chinese—Our people—the matter is one; why alone forbid and make them part?
translations.idiomatic: Barbarian and Chinese are alike Our people; why alone forbid and part them?

sentences.zh: 外可即檢任子館及東館並帶保任在外者，並賜衣糧，頒之酒食，遂其鄉路，所之阻遠，便發遣船仗衛送，必令安達。

translations.literal: Without, let the Office of Hostage Sons and the Eastern Office and those bearing guarded hostages outside all be given clothing and grain, wine and food distributed, and their homeward road followed; where the road is blocked far, then dispatch ships and guards to escort, and they must be made to arrive in safety.
translations.idiomatic: Let the Office of Hostage Sons and the Eastern Office and guarded hostages abroad receive clothing and grain, wine and food, and the homeward road; where the road is far, dispatch ships and guards so they arrive safe.

sentences.zh: 若已預仕宦及別有事義不欲去者，亦隨其意。」

translations.literal: If any have already entered office or for other reasons of duty do not wish to go, it is likewise as they wish."
translations.idiomatic: If any have already entered office or for other duty do not wish to go, it is likewise as they wish."

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉朔，以明威將軍、通直散騎常侍孫瑒為中護軍。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, guiyou, Bright Prestige General and Regular Attendant of the Direct Communication Bureau Sun Yan was made protector general.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, guiyou, Sun Yan, bright prestige general and regular attendant of the direct communication bureau, was made protector general.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, xinwei day, a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn on xinwei day a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 是月，江水色赤如血，自京師至于荊州。

translations.literal: That month the river water's color was red like blood, from the capital to Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month the river ran red as blood from the capital to Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未夜，天有聲如風水相撀。

translations.literal: On the night of guiwei day in the eighth month heaven had a sound like wind and water striking together.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of guiwei in the eighth month heaven sounded like wind and water striking together.

sentences.zh: 乙酉夜亦如之。

translations.literal: On the night of yiyou day it was again so.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of yiyou it was again so.

sentences.zh: 景戌，以使持節、都督緣江諸軍事、安西將軍魯廣達為安左將軍。

translations.literal: On gengxu day the bearer of credentials, Area Commander over the armies along the river, and Pacify West General Lu Guangda was made Secure-the-Left General.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Lu Guangda, credential bearer, area commander along the river, and pacify west general, was made secure-the-left general.

sentences.zh: 九月景午，設無㝵大會於太極殿，捨身及乘輿御服，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, wuwu day, a Boundless Assembly was held in the Hall of the Supreme Ultimate; the body was renounced and the imperial carriage's robes surrendered; a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on wuwu day a Boundless Assembly was held in the Hall of the Supreme Ultimate; the emperor renounced his body and imperial robes; a great amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 辛亥夜，天東北有聲如蟲飛，漸移西北。

translations.literal: On the night of xinhai day heaven in the northeast had a sound like insects flying, gradually moving to the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of xinhai heaven in the northeast sounded like insects flying, gradually moving northwest.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On yimao day the Great White star was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the Great White was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 景寅，以驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司、揚州刺史長沙王叔堅為司空，征南將軍、江州刺史豫章王叔英即本號開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On gengyin day the General of Agile Cavalry, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of Yangzhou, Prince of Changsha Shujian, was made Minister of Works; the General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Jiangzhou, Prince of Yuzhang Shuying, received his former title and was made opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Shujian, Prince of Changsha, general of agile cavalry, opener equal to the three dukes, and Yangzhou inspector, was made minister of works; Shuying, Prince of Yuzhang, general who campaigns south and Jiangzhou inspector, received his former title and a mansion equal to the three dukes.

sentences.zh: 至德元年春正月壬寅，詔曰：「朕以寡薄，嗣守鴻基，哀惸切慮，疹恙纏織，訓俗少方，臨下靡筭，懼甚踐冰，慄同馭朽。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Zhide, renyin day, an edict said: "We, of meager worth, have succeeded to guard the great foundation; orphaned and trembling, illness winds about Us; in training custom We have little method, in facing those below no reckoning; Our dread is like treading ice, Our fear like driving rotten wood.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of Zhide year 1 on renyin day an edict said: "We, slight in merit, guard the great foundation; orphaned and trembling, illness winds about Us; We have little method in custom and no reckoning below; Our dread is treading ice, Our fear driving rotten wood.

sentences.zh: 而四氣易流，三光遄至，纓紱列陛，玉帛充庭，具物匪新，節序疑舊，緬思前德，永慕昔辰，對軒闥而哽心，顧扆筵而慓氣。

translations.literal: Yet the four seasons easily flow and the three luminaries swiftly arrive; tassels and ribbons line the steps and jade and silk fill the court; the objects are not new yet the seasons seem old; gazing on former virtue, We ever think of past hours; facing the hall door Our heart chokes, looking at the throne mat Our breath falters.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the four seasons flow and the three luminaries come; tassels line the steps and jade fills the court; things are not new yet seasons seem old; gazing on former virtue We think of past hours; facing the hall Our heart chokes, at the throne mat Our breath falters.

sentences.zh: 思所以仰遵遺構，俯勵薄躬，陶鑄九流，休息百姓，用弘寬簡，取協陽和。

translations.literal: We think how to look up and follow the surviving structure, bend down and encourage Our slight person, mold and cast the nine streams, rest the hundred surnames, using broad simplicity to harmonize with yang harmony.
translations.idiomatic: We mean to follow the surviving design, encourage Our slight person, mold the nine streams, rest the hundred surnames, and use broad simplicity to harmonize with spring.

sentences.zh: 可大赦天下，改太建十五年為至德元年。

translations.literal: A great amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm; Taijian year fifteen is changed to Zhide year one.
translations.idiomatic: A great amnesty is proclaimed; Taijian year 15 is renamed Zhide year 1.

sentences.zh: 」以征南將軍、江州刺史、新除開府儀同三司豫章王叔英為中衛大將軍，驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司、揚州刺史長沙王叔堅為江州刺史，征東將軍、開府儀同三司、東揚州刺史司馬消難進號車騎將軍，宣惠將軍、丹陽尹晉熙王叔文為揚州刺史，鎮南將軍、南豫州刺史任忠為領軍將軍，安左將軍魯廣達為平南將軍、南豫州刺史，祠部尚書江總為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: The General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Jiangzhou, newly appointed opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Prince of Yuzhang Shuying, was made Grand General of the Central Guard; the General of Agile Cavalry, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of Yangzhou, Prince of Changsha Shujian, was made Inspector of Jiangzhou; the General Who Campaigns East, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of East Yangzhou, Sima Xiaonan, was advanced in title to General of Chariots and Cavalry; the Manifest Grace General and Administrator of Danyang, Prince of Jinxi Shuwu, was made Inspector of Yangzhou; the General Who Garrisons South and Inspector of South Yuzhou Ren Zhong was made Central Army Commander; Secure-the-Left General Lu Guangda was made Pacify South General and Inspector of South Yuzhou; Minister of Rites Jiang Zong was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Shuying, Prince of Yuzhang, general who campaigns south, Jiangzhou inspector, and newly opener equal to the three dukes, was made grand general of the central guard; Shujian, Prince of Changsha, general of agile cavalry, opener equal to the three dukes, and Yangzhou inspector, was made Jiangzhou inspector; Sima Xiaonan, general who campaigns east, opener equal to the three dukes, and East Yangzhou inspector, was promoted to general of chariots and cavalry; Shuwu, Prince of Jinxi, manifest grace general and Danyang administrator, was made Yangzhou inspector; Ren Zhong, general who garrisons south and South Yuzhou inspector, was made central army commander; Lu Guangda, secure-the-left general, was made pacify south general and South Yuzhou inspector; Jiang Zong, minister of rites, was made minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，立皇子深為始安王。

translations.literal: On guimao day the prince Shen was established as Prince of Shian.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Prince Shen was made Prince of Shian.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，以始興王叔重為揚州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, dingchou day, the Prince of Shixing Shuzhong was made Inspector of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on dingchou day Shuzhong, Prince of Shixing, was made Yangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊辰，交州刺史李幼榮獻馴象。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, wuchen day, the Inspector of Jiaozhou Li Yourong presented tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer on wuchen day Li Yourong, inspector of Jiaozhou, presented tame elephants.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以前輕車將軍、揚州刺史晉熙王叔文為江州刺史。

translations.literal: On jichou day the former Light Chariots General and Inspector of Yangzhou, Prince of Jinxi Shuwu, was made Inspector of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Shuwu, Prince of Jinxi, former light chariots general and Yangzhou inspector, was made Jiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丁卯，以驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司長沙王叔堅為司空。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, dingmao day, the General of Agile Cavalry, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Prince of Changsha Shujian, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn on dingmao day Shujian, Prince of Changsha, general of agile cavalry and opener equal to the three dukes, was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，天東南有聲如蟲飛。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, dingsi day, heaven in the southeast had a sound like insects flying.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on dingsi day heaven in the southeast sounded like insects flying.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，立皇弟叔平為湘東王，叔敖為臨賀王，叔宣為陽山王，叔穆為西陽王。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, dingyou day, the imperial younger brother Shuping was established as Prince of Xiangdong; Shua as Prince of Linhe; Shuxuan as Prince of Yangshan; Shumu as Prince of Xiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter on dingyou day the imperial brother Shuping was made Prince of Xiangdong; Shua Prince of Linhe; Shuxuan Prince of Yangshan; Shumu Prince of Xiyang.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，侍中、安右將軍、左光祿大夫、太子少傅徐陵卒。

translations.literal: On wuxu day the palace attendant, Secure-the-Right General, Left Grand Master of the Glory, and Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent Xu Ling died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Xu Ling, palace attendant, secure-the-right general, left grand master of the glory, and junior tutor of the heir apparent, died.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，立皇弟叔儉為南安王，叔澄為南郡王，叔興為沅陵王，叔韶為岳山王，叔純為新興王。

translations.literal: On guichou day the imperial younger brother Shujian was established as Prince of Nan'an; Shucheng as Prince of Nan commandery; Shuxing as Prince of Yuanling; Shaos as Prince of Yueshan; Shuchun as Prince of Xinxing.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the imperial brother Shujian was made Prince of Nan'an; Shucheng Prince of Nan; Shuxing Prince of Yuanling; Shaos Prince of Yueshan; Shuchun Prince of Xinxing.

sentences.zh: 十二月景辰，頭和國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, gengchen day, the state of Touhe sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on gengchen day Touhe sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 司空長沙王叔堅有罪免。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Prince of Changsha Shujian, guilty, was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Shujian, Prince of Changsha, minister of works, was dismissed for crime.

sentences.zh: 戊午夜，天開自西北至東南，其內有青黃色，隆隆若雷聲。

translations.literal: On the night of wuwu day heaven opened from the northwest to the southeast; within it were blue and yellow colors, rumbling like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of wuwu heaven opened from northwest to southeast; within were blue and yellow, rumbling like thunder.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁卯，分遣大使巡省風俗。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, dingmao day, great envoys were separately sent to tour and inspect local customs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of year 2 on dingmao day great envoys were sent to tour and inspect local customs.

sentences.zh: 平南將軍、豫州刺史魯廣達進號安南將軍。

translations.literal: Pacify South General and Inspector of Yuzhou Lu Guangda was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies South.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Guangda, pacify south general and Yuzhou inspector, was promoted to general who pacifies south.

sentences.zh: [10]癸巳，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Editorial footnote marker 10. On guisi day a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: [10] On guisi day a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊子，以尚書僕射永陽王伯智為平東將軍、東揚州刺史，輕車將軍、江州刺史晉熙王叔文為信威將軍、湘州刺史，仁威將軍、揚州刺史始興王叔重為江州刺史，信武將軍、南琅邪彭城二郡太守南平王嶷為揚州刺史，吏部尚書江總為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, wuzi day, the Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing, Prince of Yongyang Bozhi, was made Pacify East General and Inspector of East Yangzhou; the Light Chariots General and Inspector of Jiangzhou, Prince of Jinxi Shuwu, was made Trustworthy Might General and Inspector of Xiangzhou; the Benevolent Might General and Inspector of Yangzhou, Prince of Shixing Shuzhong, was made Inspector of Jiangzhou; the Trustworthy Martial General and Administrator of Nan Langye and Pengcheng, Prince of Nanping Yan, was made Inspector of Yangzhou; Minister of Personnel Jiang Zong was made Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer on wuzi day Bozhi, Prince of Yongyang, vice minister, was made pacify east general and East Yangzhou inspector; Shuwu, Prince of Jinxi, light chariots general and Jiangzhou inspector, was made trustworthy might general and Xiangzhou inspector; Shuzhong, Prince of Shixing, benevolent might general and Yangzhou inspector, was made Jiangzhou inspector; Yan, Prince of Nanping, trustworthy martial general and administrator of Nan Langye and Pengcheng, was made Yangzhou inspector; Jiang Zong, minister of personnel, was made vice minister.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，以長沙王叔堅為侍中、鎮左將軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, wuchen day, Prince of Changsha Shujian was made palace attendant and Garrison-the-Left General.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn on wuchen day Shujian, Prince of Changsha, was made palace attendant and garrison-the-left general.

sentences.zh: 壬午，太子加元服，在位文武賜帛各有差，孝悌力田為父後者各賜一級，鰥寡癃老不能自存者人穀五斛。

translations.literal: On renyang day the crown prince received capping; civil and military in office were each bestowed silk according to rank; filial sons, dutiful brothers, and strong farmers who are heirs to their fathers were each granted one step; widowers, widows, the aged and infirm who cannot support themselves were given five hu of grain per person.
translations.idiomatic: On renyang day the crown prince received capping; civil and military in post received silk by rank; the filial, dutiful, strong farmers, and heirs each one step; widowers, widows, and the aged who cannot support themselves received five hu of grain each.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, guiwei day, the Great White star was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on guiwei day the Great White was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，詔曰：「耕鑿自足，乃曰淳風，貢賦之興，其來尚矣。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, jiyou day, an edict said: "Plow and chisel suffice for oneself—this is called pure custom; the rise of tribute and tax is of long standing.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter on jiyou day an edict said: "Plow and chisel suffice—that is pure custom; tribute and tax are of long standing.

sentences.zh: 蓋由庚極務，不獲已而行焉。

translations.literal: It is because the pole of the year is busy and one cannot but act.
translations.idiomatic: It is because the year's pole is busy and one cannot but act.

sentences.zh: 但法令滋章，姦盜多有，俗尚澆詐，政鮮惟良。

translations.literal: Yet laws and orders grow daily; theft and robbery are many; custom esteems shallow fraud; government rarely has the good.
translations.idiomatic: Yet laws multiply; theft is rife; custom esteems fraud; government rarely finds the good.

sentences.zh: 朕日旰夜分，矜一物之失所，泣辜罪己，愧三千之未措。

translations.literal: We toil from sun to deep night, pitying the loss of a single thing; We weep over guilt and blame Ourselves, ashamed that three thousand have not been set right.
translations.idiomatic: We toil from sun to deep night, pitying the loss of a single thing; We weep over guilt and blame Ourselves, ashamed that three thousand have not been set right.

sentences.zh: 望訂初下，使彊蔭兼出，如聞貧富均起，單弱重弊，斯豈振窮扇暍之意歟？

translations.literal: The wang-ding tax was just promulgated, making strong shade issue together; We hear rich and poor alike are levied and the solitary weak doubly harmed—is this the intent to revive the exhausted and fan the sunstruck?
translations.idiomatic: The wang-ding tax was just promulgated, making strong and shade levy together; We hear rich and poor alike are taxed and the weak doubly harmed—is this how to revive the exhausted?

sentences.zh: 是乃下吏箕斂之苛也。

translations.literal: This is the harshness of lower clerks' rake and gather.
translations.idiomatic: This is the harshness of petty clerks' rake and gather.

sentences.zh: 故云『百姓不足，君孰與足』。

translations.literal: Thus it is said, 'If the people are not sufficient, with whom is the ruler sufficient?'
translations.idiomatic: Thus it is said, 'If the people are not sufficient, with whom is the ruler sufficient?'

sentences.zh: 自太建十四年望訂租調逋未入者，並悉原除。

translations.literal: From Taijian year fourteen, wang-ding rent and tax not yet entered, all are pardoned and remitted.
translations.idiomatic: From Taijian year 14, wang-ding rent and tax not yet paid in, all are pardoned and remitted.

sentences.zh: 在事百僚，辯斷庶務，必去取平允，無得便公害民，為己聲績，妨紊政道。」

translations.literal: The hundred officials in charge of affairs, in judging the multitude of tasks, must remove and take what is level and fair; they must not use convenience to harm the people, make reputation for themselves, or obstruct and disorder the way of government."
translations.idiomatic: Officials in charge must judge affairs fairly, not use convenience to harm the people, make reputation for themselves, or obstruct government."

sentences.zh: 十一月景寅，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, gengyin day, a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on gengyin day a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬申，盤盤國遣使獻方物。
